Our Integrated Cognitive Toolkit

Each tool is a gateway to a deeper level of learning and self-awareness.

01 · Socratic AI

MindProbe

Engage with an AI that challenges you with thoughtful questions to build lasting knowledge. Rather than surface-level answers, it pushes you to analyze, connect concepts and refine your logic.

  • Promote critical thinking over rote memorization
  • Identify and address gaps in understanding
  • Simulate a one-on-one tutoring experience
02 · Neuro analytics

Brain Lens

Analyze brainwave data to understand cognitive load, fatigue and engagement. A deep, neurological view of the learning state to find the optimal conditions for learning.

  • Measure cognitive effort and mental fatigue
  • Neurological view of the learning state
  • Identify optimal conditions for learning
03 · Exam readiness

Testarena

Take real exam-style mock tests for CET, NEET and JEE and see where you stand among thousands of students, with ML-powered insights on your accuracy, speed and problem-solving approach.
